headline: Reserve Bank of India Lowers Minimum Daily CRR Maintenance to 90%
summary: The Reserve Bank of India reduced the minimum daily cash reserve ratio maintenance requirement for banks from 99% to 90%, effective December 1, to ease operational constraints.
why: Adjusting cash reserve requirements directly alters systemic banking liquidity and lenders' short-term operational flexibility.

impacts.name: Indian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Lowering the daily cash reserve ratio requirement eases liquidity constraints and operational burdens for commercial banks.
